storylines.text: Byron Buxton is running hot right now, hitting well above his 0.274 season average over his last games with at least one home run in that stretch. He faces CLE sends out Gavin Williams today, in a pitcher-friendly park, a pitcher who's allowed a 0.226 average against this season. This pitcher has also been genuinely tougher to hit hard once he gets to two strikes this season, not just generically good.
